Before we get to work.

Good questions. Straight answers.

How much will my website cost?

Our website offer is $999 USD, one-time, for up to three pages, custom design, and up to three revisions. Domain, hosting, and support are optional at $99/month.

How long does it take to build?

It depends on the pages, photos, and time for feedback. We’ll agree on a schedule before we start.

What do you need from me?

A few details about your services and service area, plus photos of your finished work. If anything is missing, we’ll let you know.

Will I own my website and keep my domain?

We’ll confirm who owns the website, how hosting works, and whether you can keep your domain before work begins. If email is connected to your domain, we’ll check that setup before making any changes.

Will a new website bring me more jobs?

A better website can help homeowners see your work and contact you. It can’t promise more jobs; that also depends on who finds you, your area, and your reputation.
